    <el:luamain><![CDATA[
-- For aesthetics; make it harder to tell whether we're playing as YIN
-- or YANG by removing the extra lifes from the inventory. (There's no
-- way to die other than F3, anyway; and we don't want players to F3
-- on this level, it would be a shortcut.)
wo["ProvideExtralifes"] = false

-- Camera trickery. We want to follow the apparently "active" ball at
-- all times. But only the black ball can cross the centre lines, so
-- let's let it do the scrolling.
wo["FollowGrid"] = true
wo["FollowMethod"] = FOLLOW_FLIP
wo["FollowThreshold"] = 0.5

-- invisible sensor to prevent the dropping of items
ti[" "] = {"fl_rock",adhesion=0} .. ti({"it_sensor", invisible=true})
ti["!"] = {"fl_water"}
ti["x"] = {"st_oxyd_a", name="oxyd_#"}
ti["#"] = ti[" "] .. {"st_granite"}
ti["`"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_onw", name="nw_mainslope_#", adhesion=0}
ti[","] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_osw", name="sw_mainslope_#", adhesion=0}
ti["."] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_ose", name="se_mainslope_#", adhesion=0}
ti["'"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_one", name="ne_mainslope_#", adhesion=0}
ti[")"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_tel", adhesion=0}
ti["("] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_twl", adhesion=0}
ti["]"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_ter", adhesion=0}
ti["["] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_twr", adhesion=0}
ti["u"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_tsr", adhesion=0}
ti["n"] = (ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_tnl", adhesion=0})
                   .. {"it_sensor", invisible=true, action="callback", target="callback_1"}
ti["U"] = (ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_tsl", adhesion=0})
                   .. {"it_sensor", invisible=true, action="callback", target="callback_4"}
ti["N"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_tnr", adhesion=0}
ti["1"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_onw", adhesion=0, slope=NORTH}
ti["2"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_one", adhesion=0, slope=NORTH}
ti["3"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_osw", adhesion=0, slope=SOUTH}
ti["4"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_ose", adhesion=0, slope=SOUTH}
ti["5"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_onw", adhesion=0, slope=WEST}
ti["6"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_one", adhesion=0, slope=EAST}
ti["7"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_osw", adhesion=0, slope=WEST}
ti["8"] = ti[" "] .. {"fl_slope_ose", adhesion=0, slope=EAST}
ti["A"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_black", orientation=NORTH}) .. {"fl_slope_pn", adhesion=0}
ti["V"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_black", orientation=SOUTH}) .. {"fl_slope_ps", adhesion=0}
ti["C"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_black", orientation=WEST}) .. {"fl_slope_pw", adhesion=0}
ti["D"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_black", orientation=EAST}) .. {"fl_slope_pe", adhesion=0}
ti["^"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_white", orientation=NORTH}) .. {"fl_slope_pn", adhesion=0}
ti["v"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_white", orientation=SOUTH}) .. {"fl_slope_ps", adhesion=0}
ti["<"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_white", orientation=WEST}) .. {"fl_slope_pw", adhesion=0}
ti[">"] = (ti[" "] .. {"st_oneway_white", orientation=EAST}) .. {"fl_slope_pe", adhesion=0}
ti["O"] = ((ti[" "] ..
           {"#ac_marble_white", essential=INDISPENSABLE}) ..
           {"fl_slope_onw", name="centreslope", adhesion=0, friction=50, strength=100}) ..
           {"st_granite_hollow"}
ti["a"] = ti["A"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_1"}
ti["b"] = ti["A"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_2"}
ti["c"] = ti["V"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_3"}
ti["d"] = ti["V"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_4"}
ti["e"] = ti["C"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_1"}
ti["f"] = ti["C"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_3"}
ti["g"] = ti["D"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_4"}
ti["h"] = ti["D"] .. {"it_sensor", action="callback", target="callback_2"}
ti["o"] = ti["'"] .. {"#ac_marble_black", essential=INDISPENSABLE}

if wo["IsDifficult"] then
    ti["r"] = ti[">"]
    ti["R"] = ti["<"]
    ti["s"] = ti["^"]
    ti["S"] = ti["v"]
else
    ti["r"] = ti["#"]
    ti["R"] = ti["#"]
    ti["s"] = ti["#"]
    ti["S"] = ti["#"]
end

-- For the camera trick to work properly, this map has to be exactly 2x2 screens.
w, h = wo(ti, " ", {
    "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!",
    "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!",
    "!#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#!",
    "!r'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'h.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.r!",
    "!#AxV#A#V#A#V#A#V#AxV#A#V#A#V#A#V#AxV#!",
    "!R`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`e,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,R!",
    "!#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#!",
    "!r'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'h.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.r!",
    "!#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#!",
    "!R`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`e,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,R!",
    "!#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#!",
    "!r'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.>o#.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.r!",
    "!#axc#a#c#a#c#a#c##O##b#d#b#d#b#d#bxd#!",
    "!R`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`#,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,R!",
    "!#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#!",
    "!r'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'g.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.r!",
    "!#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#A#V#!",
    "!R`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`f,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,R!",
    "!#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#^#v#!",
    "!r'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'g.>'D.>'D.>'D.>'D.r!",
    "!#AxV#A#V#A#V#A#V#AxV#A#V#A#V#A#V#AxV#!",
    "!R`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`f,<`C,<`C,<`C,<`C,R!",
    "!#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#s#S#!",
    "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!",
    "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"})

wo:add(YIN, {"it_ring"})
wo:shuffleOxyd({no["oxyd_#*"]:sort("circular"), circular=true})

-- Shuffle around the arrow colours in II, otherwise it's the same as I,
-- but the two versions play rather differently
for nw in no["nw_mainslope_#*"] do
    if random(2) == 1 then
        x = st(nw+{-1,0})
        y = st(nw+{0,-1})
        if x:is("st_oneway") and y:is("st_oneway") then
            x.color = cond(x.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
            y.color = cond(y.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
        end
    end
end

for ne in no["ne_mainslope_#*"] do
    if random(2) == 1 then
        x = st(ne+{1,0})
        y = st(ne+{0,-1})
        if x:is("st_oneway") and y:is("st_oneway") then
            x.color = cond(x.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
            y.color = cond(y.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
        end
    end
end

for sw in no["sw_mainslope_#*"] do
    if random(2) == 1 then
        x = st(sw+{-1,0})
        y = st(sw+{0,1})
        if x:is("st_oneway") and y:is("st_oneway") then
            x.color = cond(x.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
            y.color = cond(y.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
        end
    end
end

for se in no["se_mainslope_#*"] do
    if random(2) == 1 then
        x = st(se+{1,0})
        y = st(se+{0,1})
        if x:is("st_oneway") and y:is("st_oneway") then
            x.color = cond(x.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
            y.color = cond(y.color==BLACK,WHITE,BLACK)
        end
    end
end

-- Callbacks. These don't affect gameplay, just set up camera trickery.
function callback_1()
    no["centreslope"].slope = NORTHWEST
end

function callback_2()
    no["centreslope"].slope = NORTHEAST
end

function callback_3()
    no["centreslope"].slope = SOUTHWEST
end

function callback_4()
    no["centreslope"].slope = SOUTHEAST
end
 ]]></el:luamain>

function way_thru()
    x = 3    
    y = math.random(1, 4)
    prev_prev_dir = 3
    prev_dir = 3
    dir = 3

    while x < 15 do
        if x < 4 then
            x = x+1
        elseif prev_dir == 2 then
            if dir == 1 and prev_prev_dir ~=3 then y = y-1
            elseif dir == 3 and prev_prev_dir ~= 1 then y = y+1
            else x = x+1 end
        elseif prev_dir == 1 then
            if dir == 1 and prev_prev_dir ~= 3 then y = y-1
            else x = x+1 end
        else
            if dir == 3 and prev_prev_dir ~= 1 then y = y+1
            else x = x+1 end
        end

        prev_prev_dir = prev_dir
        prev_dir = dir
        dir = math.random(1,3)

        if y < 1 then y = y+1
        elseif y > 4 then y = y-1
        else
            wo[{x, y}] = {"fl_dunes"}..ti{"it_nil"}

end

wo["ConserveLevel"] = true
wo["FollowGrid"] = true
wo["FollowMethod"] = FOLLOW_SCROLL
wo["FollowAction"] = FOLLOW_HALFSCREEN

textcount = {u = 9, r = 10, d = 10, l = 10, nl = 5, nu = 4, nr = 6, nd = 4}

ti[" "] = {"fl_abyss"}
ti["."] = {"fl_wood"}
ti["-"] = {"fl_samba"}
ti["~"] = {"it_trap"} .. ti["-"]
ti["#"] = {"st_brick"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_pearl_black"} .. ti["."]
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd", oxydcolor = OXYD_PURPLE}
ti["P"] = {"fl_platinum_framed"}
ti["1"] = {"it_trigger", invisible = true, _dir = "r", target = "change_text"}
ti["2"] = {"it_trigger", invisible = true, _dir = "l", target = "change_text"}
ti["3"] = {"it_trigger", invisible = true, _dir = "d", target = "change_text"}
ti["4"] = {"it_trigger", invisible = true, _dir = "u", target = "change_text"}

lastpos = po(2,2)
function change_text(onoff, sender)
    if onoff == true then
        wo[lastpos] = {"st_nil"}
        local pos1, dpos
        local dir = sender._dir
        if dir == "r" then  dpos = po(-1,  0)  end
        if dir == "l" then  dpos = po( 1,  0)  end
        if dir == "d" then  dpos = po( 0, -1)  end
        if dir == "u" then  dpos = po( 0,  1)  end
        pos1 = po(sender) + 2*dpos
        if fl(pos1)["_enter-"..dir] == nil then
            local type = fl(pos1)["_type"]
            local typewithout = string.gsub(type, dir, "")
            local text = "text-"
            if string.len(type) == 1 then
                text = text .. type .. random(textcount[type])
            end
            if string.len(type) == 2 then
                text = text .. typewithout .. random(textcount[typewithout])
            end
            if string.len(type) == 3 then
                local missing = string.gsub("nurdl", "[" .. type .. "]", "")
                text = text .. missing .. random(textcount[missing])
            end
            if string.len(type) == 4 then
                text = text .. "n" .. dir .. random(textcount["n" .. dir])
            end
            fl(pos1)["_enter-"..dir] = text
        end
        wo[pos1] = {"st_document", text = fl(pos1)["_enter-"..dir]}
        lastpos = pos1
    end
end


map_mini = {
    r    = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "~.P.1", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    l    = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "2.P.~", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    d    = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "~.P.~", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    u    = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "~.P.~", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    rl   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "2.P.1", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    du   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "~.P.~", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    ru   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "~.P.1", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    rd   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "~.P.1", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    lu   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "2.P.~", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    ld   = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "2.P.~", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    rlu  = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "2.P.1", " ... ", "  ~  "}),
    rld  = wo:newMap(" ", {"  ~  ", " ... ", "2.P.1", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    rdu  = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "~.P.1", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    ldu  = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "2.P.~", " ... ", "  3  "}),
    rldu = wo:newMap(" ", {"  4  ", " ... ", "2.P.1", " ... ", "  3  "})}

maze_width = 6
maze_height = 6

whole_map = wo:newMap(" ", maze_width*5, maze_height*5)

if wo["IsDifficult"] then
  maze = new_kruskal_maze(maze_width, maze_height)
else
  maze = new_kruskal_maze(maze_width/2, maze_height/2)
end

-- The following tables help to form a unicursal 6x6-maze from
-- a perfect 3x3-maze. The idea is to bisect each passage of the
-- 3x3-maze, yielding 2x2 cells per original cell. The following
-- tables encodes the pathways of the 4 new cells, depending on
-- the original paths and the position of the new cell within the
-- 2x2 grid.
unicursal_translation = {
  head = { "r",  "l",  "d",  "u", "rl", "du", "ru", "rd", "lu", "ld", "rlu", "rld", "rdu", "ldu", "rldu"},
     l = {"rd", "rl", "rd", "du", "rl", "du", "du", "rd", "lu", "rl",  "lu",  "rl",  "du",  "lu",  "lu"},
    ly = {"ru", "rl", "du", "ru", "rl", "du", "ru", "du", "rl", "ld",  "rl",  "ld",  "du",  "ld",  "ld"},
    lx = {"rl", "ld", "ld", "du", "rl", "du", "ru", "rl", "du", "ld",  "ru",  "rl",  "ru",  "du",  "ru"},
   lxy = {"rl", "lu", "du", "lu", "rl", "du", "rl", "rd", "lu", "du",  "rl",  "rd",  "rd",  "du",  "rd"}}

function celltype(x,y)
  if wo["IsDifficult"] then
    local type = ""
    if maze:can_go_east(x,y)  then  type = type .. "r"  end
    if maze:can_go_west(x,y)  then  type = type .. "l"  end
    if maze:can_go_south(x,y) then  type = type .. "d"  end
    if maze:can_go_north(x,y) then  type = type .. "u"  end
    return type
  else
    --if (x == 1) and (y == 1) then
    --  return "d"
    --end
    local minitype = ""
    local type = ""
    minix = math.floor(x/2)
    miniy = math.floor(y/2)
    translation_line = "l"
    if x > 2*minix then  translation_line = translation_line .. "x"  end
    if y > 2*miniy then  translation_line = translation_line .. "y"  end
    if maze:can_go_east(minix,miniy)  then  minitype = minitype .. "r"  end
    if maze:can_go_west(minix,miniy)  then  minitype = minitype .. "l"  end
    if maze:can_go_south(minix,miniy) then  minitype = minitype .. "d"  end
    if maze:can_go_north(minix,miniy) then  minitype = minitype .. "u"  end
    --if (x == 2) and (y == 1) then
    --  return string.gsub(type, "l", "")
    --end
    for j = 1, 15 do
      if unicursal_translation.head[j] == minitype then
        return unicursal_translation[translation_line][j]
      end
    end
    print("Error in unicursal translation.")
    return ""    
  end
end

for y = 0, maze_height - 1 do
  for x = 0, maze_width - 1 do
    whole_map:paste(map_mini[celltype(x,y)], 5*po(x,y))
  end
end

if wo["IsDifficult"] then
  whole_map[{1,1}] = "@"
  whole_map[{0,0}] = "O"
  whole_map[{5*maze_width-1, 5*maze_height-1}] = "O"
else
  whole_map[{3,3}] = "@"
  whole_map[{0,7}] = "O"
  whole_map[{7,0}] = "O"
end

w, h = wo(ti, "-", whole_map)
wo:drawBorder(po(0, 0), w, h, ti[" "])

for y = 0, maze_height - 1 do
  for x = 0, maze_width - 1 do
    fl(5*po(x,y) + po(2,2))._type = celltype(x,y)
  end
end

if wo["IsDifficult"] then
  if it(2,4)._dir == nil then
    change_text(true, it(4,2))
  else
    change_text(true, it(2,4))
  end
else
  wo[{4,2}] = {"fl_abyss"}
  wo[{5,2}] = {"fl_abyss"}
  wo[{2,4}] = {"it_nil"}
  wo[{9,2}] = {"it_nil"}
  wo[{7,4}] = {"it_nil"}
end


    ]]></el:luamain>

    <el:string el:key="text1">
		<el:english el:translate="true">Caesar's original Cipher has a shift of +3 to protect messages of military significance ("Caesar" = "Fdhvdu"). Goto the cross +3 and wait for 5 seconds.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">Cäsars original Chiffre hat eine Verschiebung von +3, um militärische Nachrichten zu verschlüsseln ("Caesar" = "Fdhvdu"). Gehe zu Kreuz +3 und warte für 5 Sekunden.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text2">
		<el:english el:translate="true">Decrypt "BkfdjX" (Hint 1: Cipher Machine, Hint 2: a game). The used shift is different from the original Caesar-Cipher. Goto the cross of the new shift and remember for later use.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">Entschlüssele "BkfdjX" (Hinweis 1: Chiffiermaschine, Hinweis 2: ein Spiel). Die Verschiebung ist eine andere, als bei der Original Cäsar-Chiffre. Gehe zum Kreuz der neuen Verschiebung und merke sie dir.</el:translation>
	</el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text3">
		<el:english el:translate="true">Goto the cross +9.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">Gehe zu Kreuz +9.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text4">
		<el:english el:translate="true">9 AD (Anno Domini) - Battle of the Teutoburg Forest.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">9 n. Chr. - Schlacht im Teutoburger Wald.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text5">
		<el:english el:translate="true">14 AD (Anno Domini) - Death of Augustus. Goto cross 14 AD.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">14 n. Chr. - Tod von Augustus. Gehe zum Kreuz 14 n. Chr.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text6">
		<el:english el:translate="true">63 BC (Before Christ) - Augustus was born. What happened 33 years later?</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">63 v. Chr. - Geburt von Augustus. Was passierte 33 Jahre später?</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text7">
		<el:english el:translate="true">52 BC (Before Christ) - Battle of Alesia.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">52 v. Chr. - Schlacht um Alesia.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text8">
		<el:english el:translate="true">30 BC - Antonius and Cleopatra committed suicide. Goto Nero's 27 birthday.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">30 v. Chr. - Antonius und Kleopatra begehen Selbstmord. Gehe zu Neros 27. Geburtstag.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text9">
		<el:english el:translate="true">37 AD - Nero was born.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">37 n. Chr. - Geburt von Nero.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text10">
		<el:english el:translate="true">64 AD - Great Fire of Rome.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">64 n. Chr - Großer Brand Roms.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text11">
		<el:english el:translate="true">Decrypt "Farp JXoqff" to Latin words by using the remembered shift. Goto the year of this event.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">Entschlüssele "Farp JXoqff" zu lateinischen Worten durch Verwendung der gemerkten Verschiebung. Gehe zum Jahr des Ereignisses.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text12">
		<el:english el:translate="true">44 BC - Ides of March, Assassination of Caesar.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">44 v. Chr. - Iden des März, Attentat auf Cäsar.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
	<el:string el:key="text13">
		<el:english el:translate="true">Wrong shift or year. Restart level.</el:english>
		<el:translation el:lang="de">Falsche Verschiebung oder falsches Jahr. Starte den Level neu.</el:translation>
    </el:string>
</el:protected>
</el:level>
